name: SLC monoamine neurotransmitter transport and transporter disease defects
rationale: All members concern transporter-mediated uptake or vesicular loading of monoamine neurotransmitters, chiefly norepinephrine and dopamine, and unlike the confusables (generic catecholamine transport, synthesis, degradation) the theme carries the SLC transporter view and the SLC6A2/SLC6A3 disease variants.

name: TCR signaling with CD28 costimulation and co-inhibition
rationale: Members cover TCR proximal and downstream signaling, T cell activation and differentiation, plus CD28 costimulation and CTLA4/BTLA co-inhibition, which distinguish it from confusables centred on BCR signaling, thymocyte development or CD27/B cell proliferation.

name: Ear and olfactory placode derivative development
rationale: Members are morphogenesis of inner, middle and outer ear plus olfactory nerve, nose, cranial ganglia and GnRH neuron migration from the olfactory placode, setting it apart from confusables about face/skull, eye or gland development.

qualifier: G protein and calcium channel control of glutamate/GABA release
name: Presynaptic G protein and calcium control of glutamate/GABA release
rationale: Members regulate glutamate and GABA release from the presynaptic terminal via Gi/o-coupled receptors, GIRK and Gbeta-gamma inhibition of calcium channels and presynaptic calcium/membrane potential, unlike confusables about vesicle docking/SNARE release cycles, postsynaptic receptors or inhibitory synapse assembly.

name: Sprouting angiogenesis and endothelial proliferation with FGF restraint
rationale: Members regulate angiogenic sprouting, vessel branching and vascular endothelial proliferation, and the negative regulation of FGF production and chemotaxis distinguishes it from VEGF/Tie2-centred or endothelial activation/apoptosis confusables.

name: Nuclear estrogen receptor signaling and transcriptional estrogen response
rationale: Members are cellular responses to estrogen/estradiol, estrogen-dependent gene expression and early/late estrogen response signatures (with progesterone receptor and AP-2 co-regulation), distinguished from androgen-receptor confusables and from the GPER1/estrous-cycle neighbour by the nuclear ER transcriptional programme.

name: Classical and alternative complement activation
rationale: All members concern complement activation via the antibody-mediated classical and the alternative pathway and its positive regulation, unlike confusables centred on lectin/ficolin activation, C3/C5 cleavage and opsonization or on negative regulation of complement.

core: Organic ion and xenobiotic transmembrane transport
name: Xenobiotic efflux and organic ion transmembrane transport
rationale: Members are transmembrane transport of xenobiotics (export, blood-brain barrier) and of organic cations/anions including alpha-ketoglutarate, distinguished from monocarboxylate/dicarboxylate transporter and drug-ADME/SLCO organic anion confusables by xenobiotic export and organic cation transport.

name: Semaphorin 3A axon repulsion and nerve branching
rationale: Members are Sema3A-plexin repulsive signaling via CRMPs, PAK and integrin inhibition, together with nerve branching and suppression of microtubule polymerization, distinguishing it from netrin, ephrin, collateral sprouting and generic axon guidance confusables.

core: Sulfur amino acid and glutathione metabolism
qualifier: selenium compound metabolism and glutathione-cycle defects
name: Sulfur amino acid, glutathione and selenium compound metabolism
rationale: Members cover cysteine/transsulfuration, sulfide and H2S metabolism, glutathione synthesis, recycling, transport and its inherited defects, and selenium compound metabolism, which separate it from broad amino acid/urea-cycle, carnitine/choline and aromatic amino acid confusables.

name: Nucleotide phosphorylation, interconversion and biosynthesis regulation
rationale: Members concern kinase-driven interconversion of nucleoside mono-, di- and triphosphates (ADP, GTP) and positive/negative regulation of nucleotide biosynthesis, with mitochondrial and apoptotic regulatory terms that the pyrophosphate/inositol-pyrophosphate, NAD and creatine confusables lack.

qualifier: ADP signaling via P2Y1 and P2Y12
name: ADP P2Y receptor-driven platelet activation
rationale: All members describe platelet activation driven by ADP through P2Y1 and P2Y12 purinoceptors, whereas confusables cover GPVI/collagen, GP1b-IX-V, integrin/Rap1 and aggregation regulation.

name: Sleep/wake cycle regulation and orexin neuropeptide signaling
rationale: Members regulate REM, non-REM sleep and wakefulness together with orexin/NPFF/QRFP receptor binding and nerve impulse transmission, distinguishing it from circadian clock transcription, opioid/neuropeptide signaling, feeding and social-behaviour confusables.

name: mRNA stabilization and decapping-dependent 5'-3' decay
rationale: Members balance mRNA stabilization (CRD, IGF2BPs, 3'-UTR, inhibited deadenylation-dependent decay) against decapping and 5'-to-3' exonucleolytic decay, unlike confusables focused on deadenylation/P-bodies, ARE-binding destabilizers or nonsense-mediated decay and export.

qualifier: heart tube and second heart field
name: Embryonic heart tube and second heart field development
rationale: Members cover heart tube morphogenesis and left/right patterning, second heart field specification and proliferation, ventricle formation and cardiac myoblast differentiation, unlike confusables about valves/endocardium/trabeculae, outflow tract neural crest or the conduction system.

name: EGFR and ERBB2 adaptor-mediated downstream signaling
rationale: Members are EGFR and ERBB2 (and some ERBB4) signaling through GRB2, SHC1, GRB7, PI3K, PLCG1, GAB1 and PTK6 plus EGFR transactivation and downregulation, distinguishing it from ERBB3/ERBB4-centred and MET receptor confusables.

qualifier: intracellular domain transcription and oncogenic NOTCH1 mutants
name: Notch intracellular domain transcription and oncogenic NOTCH1 signaling
rationale: Members cover Notch receptor processing, NICD-driven transcription for NOTCH1-4, and constitutive signaling by cancer-associated NOTCH1 and FBXW7 mutants, whereas confusables centre on NOTCH4 activation and regulated intramembrane proteolysis shared with ERBB4 and p75NTR.

name: Glycerophospholipid synthesis, acyl-chain remodeling and endocannabinoid metabolism
rationale: Members cover synthesis and acyl-chain remodeling of PA, PC, PE, PS, PG and cardiolipin, DAG/MAG/TAG metabolism and the endocannabinoid/N-acylethanolamine branch, unlike confusables about PI synthesis and lipid transfer, sphingolipids or lipid droplet triglyceride storage.

core: Lipid modification for protein trafficking and secretion
name: Wnt ligand secretion and RAB geranylgeranylation
rationale: Members concern Golgi-associated lipid modification and trafficking: PORCN-dependent Wnt ligand biogenesis and secretion and RAB geranylgeranylation/activation, distinguishing it from palmitoylation/Hedgehog, RAS processing and phospholipid transfer confusables.

name: Unfolded protein response via stress-induced translational repression
rationale: Members are the unfolded protein response together with stress-regulated (negative) control of translation initiation, setting it apart from confusables built on ATF4, ATF6, XBP1 and CREB3 transcriptional arms and ER-stress apoptosis.

name: Type I interferon-stimulated gene response with ISG15 conjugation
rationale: Members are type I interferon/IFN-alpha response and antiviral ISG signatures including IRF2 target networks and ISG15 conjugation, distinguishing it from confusables on OAS/PKR and IFN signaling regulation, host restriction of viral replication, cytosolic DNA sensing or RIG-I-like receptor signaling.

qualifier: processing, modification, stability and ribosome assembly
name: Mitochondrial RNA processing, modification, stability and ribosome assembly
rationale: Members concern mitochondrial tRNA/rRNA/mRNA processing, modification, import, stability and decay plus mitoribosome subunit assembly, unlike confusables on mitochondrial translation steps, mtDNA replication/transcription, nuclear tRNA processing or pseudouridylation.

qualifier: restraint of TGF-beta response and matrix assembly
name: Wound connective tissue replacement and TGF-beta/matrix assembly restraint
rationale: The three members tie connective tissue replacement in inflammatory wound healing to negative regulation of TGF-beta responses and extracellular matrix assembly, whereas confusables concern fibroblast/myofibroblast differentiation and migration or endothelial regulation.

name: Ureteric bud and nephric duct morphogenesis
rationale: Members cover nephric/mesonephric duct formation, ureteric bud formation, elongation and branching, ureter morphogenesis and renal vesicle formation, distinguishing it from confusables about metanephric mesenchyme proliferation, negative regulation of kidney development or intermediate mesoderm induction.

core: Erythrocyte membrane gas and ammonium transport
name: Erythrocyte gas exchange and Rhesus ammonium transport
rationale: Members are erythrocyte O2/CO2 exchange, NO and CO2 transmembrane transport and Rhesus glycoprotein-mediated ammonium transport including RHAG deficiency, setting it apart from iron handling, heme biosynthesis and surfactant confusables.
